attempts.label: TRELLIS · standard crops · 560k
attempts.description: All four masked statue images jointly condition one generation. Standard foreground crops, stochastic view conditioning, 76 steps in both stages. Detached fragments removed; no smoothing or hole filling.

attempts.label: TRELLIS · shared framing · 344k
attempts.description: All four registered images condition each denoising step through multidiffusion, 50 steps in both stages. This shared-frame trial is softer and has more broken thin surfaces.

attempts.label: InstantMesh · camera conditioned · 123k
attempts.description: All four registered images encoded jointly with explicit front/left/back/right cameras. This experiment preserves the broad pose but has weak anatomy and lumpy surfaces.

limitations: The face and raised fingers remain softer than the images. Thin-surface defects and inferred anatomy are visible, particularly on the back and around the cloth. This is a rough reconstruction for review, not a finished game asset.
